responsibility: Is the main implementation file of GCC’s S/390 backend, containing the target hook definitions and machine-dependent code-generation logic for System z. It centralizes processor cost tables, register/class and mode legality, addressing and constant legitimacy, calling convention and frame/prologue/epilogue handling, instruction expansion and emission helpers, asm output, option-dependent behavior, scheduling/vectorization hooks, builtin/backend support routines, and the final TARGET_INITIALIZER wiring that connects the S/390 port to GCC’s middle end and RTL infrastructure.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-name s390 files, this is the executable backend implementation that defines the S/390 target hooks and helper routines, then wires them into TARGET_INITIALIZER. Unlike s390.h it provides runtime code for those interfaces rather than macro/struct definitions, unlike s390.md it is not the declarative RTL pattern file, and unlike s390.opt it does not declare command-line options and their generated variables.
